mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.cover_image AS productImage, p.price, c.quantity, c.checked, p.stock FROM cart c JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart(id, user_id, product_id, quantity, checked, create_time) VALUES(#{id}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{checked}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE cart SET checked = CASE WHEN checked = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.cover_image AS productImage, p.price, c.quantity, c.checked, p.stock FROM cart c JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.checked = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
